stage: G2 addendum only rear negative spaces, before G3
identity: Related PF7401X3 black/PF74013F red BM150 shell appearance; exact125HD currentRDC mould/paint/code not proved
frame: Isolated Blender+X riderLEFT,+Yrear,+Zup; glTF(x,y,z)=(x,z,-y). Front opening nominal planeY0, circular aperture centred atorigin. Not a certified installed transform.

orientation_evidence.known: Native product views show circular front opening with narrow rolled ring and formed wrap toward the opposite open edge; two rounded scallops and a central open-edge keyhole occur in that opposite edge.
orientation_evidence.conditional_installation_hypothesis: Interpret longer formed return as lower/side shell and the two scallops as rear lower-edge features, based on related catalog illustration and official RDC side silhouette. Product photos were held in varying poses: image-up does not mean motorcycle-up.
orientation_evidence.unproved: Scallop function, installed top/bottom mapping of every hidden pad, exact lamp/fork mating datums. Do not create fork collisions or drill every guessed support before comparison.

front_clear_aperture_radius.basis: Working fit interval near the independently estimated lamp/protector, NOT measured pixel/mm or a forced shared fit

front_outer_radius_side.basis: Photo outer/front aperture ratio varies with angular position and perspective

front_outer_radius_top.basis: Narrower lip at top, perspective photograph conditional

front_outer_radius_bottom.basis: Lower painted band visible on official front view; no physical width measurement

rear_wrap_maximum_depth.basis: Related isolated three-quarter shell view and official whole-bike side silhouette; substantial focal/depth ambiguity

rear_wrap_upper_depth.basis: Upper lip remains shorter than the side/lower formed return, conditional orientation

nominal_shell_normal_thickness.basis: Finite thin moulded shell construction assumption; not vendor or OEM thickness

lip_edge_radius.basis: Visible rolled edge needs continuous finite radius; no dimension published

rear_scallop_width_each.basis: Visible rounded open-edge negative spaces in8495; actual axial depth unconstrained

rear_scallop_depth.basis: Estimated shape ratio only, not a fork clearance certificate

rib_normal_thickness.basis: Related inner ribs visible but thickness unmeasured

mount_pad_hole_diameter.basis: Round holes visible in product views; screw size unknown

construction_sequence.surface_method: Separate angular front aperture/rolled lip, changing side shoulder and long formed rear returns by continuous spline section fields. Construct outer/inner connected surfaces at finite normal thickness. No stack of generic toroids or after-CSG global bevel.
construction_sequence.section_stations: At least front lip, shoulder, midwrap and scalloped rear edge with continuous interpolated derivatives. Top/side/lower angular sections distinct, not a uniform revolved bowl.
first_gray_checks: Whole inside quarter matching8495 negative spaces
Short neutral reflection strip over shoulder and rear edge

construction_sequence.unit: Rear open-edge scallops and central keyhole
construction_sequence.surface_method: Build real open boundary and rolled thickness, continuous spline lobes; no dark decal substituting a void. Keep open-edge versus drilled hole distinct.
construction_sequence.order: Only after outer shell perspective/negative spaces read; same active component.

construction_sequence.unit: Inner support pads and thin ribs
construction_sequence.surface_method: Six observed side pad regions and actual circular holes documented as related geometry; fitted depth/axis estimates explicit. Avoid copying a hidden mirror counterpart without evidence. CSG union only after finite volumes and normal-field prechecks.
construction_sequence.order: One observed region at a time; do not invent unseen bosses to make a supposedly complete assembly.

construction_sequence.surface_method: Only after whole gray and reflection acceptance; original procedural UV/PBR, no private photo texture or transplanted light. Red tentative(.42,.006,.012)linear, metal0rough.22 is a non-OEM candidate, not frozen common paint.

comparison_protocol.projection: Perspective views to be compared separately; no whole-photo single pixel/mm scale. Lens/pose/scale initially estimated and saved; no pixel error as calibrated fidelity until camera is actually constrained.
native_observable_checks: Front aperture and outer band proportions around full arc
Short upper lip versus longer changing rear wrap
Two rear scallop negative spaces and centre keyhole
Inside pad count, holes and rib termini against the actual related image
comparison_protocol.unknown_camera_rule: If contour mismatch can be focal/pose ambiguity, record both before deforming sections. Keep uncertainty rather than forcing a false contour fit.

blocked_parts: ExactRDC partidentity and installed mounting transform
Hidden pad dimensions/axes and hardware stack
Any claim of fit to the independently estimated housing/protector/forks without separate checks
not_in_this_component: OEM logos/stickers; originalWEWA artwork later only if visible/documented

initial_shell_study_sections.revision: s0, no detailed pads/ribs/scallops yet; not finalcowl or acceptedform
initial_shell_study_sections.coordinates: theta0=top,+pi/2=+Xleft,pi=bottom; yrear>=0. Candidate orientation as conditional in plan.
initial_shell_study_sections.wall: 2.5mm normal thickness around C1 mid-surface; rounded front and rear connected edge, not Solidify+globalbevel; values estimated
initial_shell_study_sections.symmetric_estimate: Only gross shell section is provisionally mirrored; detailed pads/asymmetries not silently replicated as observed.
initial_shell_study_sections.first_read_before_detail: Three graywhole views and one reflection detail. Form/camera corrections before adding observed scallops and pads.
initial_shell_study_sections.curve_method: Clamped cubic B-spline; control polygon estimated, not interpolation or measured sections. No Catmull overshoot. Actual minimum radius/parallel offset quality must pass before image.
initial_shell_study_sections.numerical_geometry: Spline/finite-difference/normal-offset calculations inFloat64; only final mesh positions quantized once toFloat32, to prevent derivative noise from entering thin-wall construction.

coarse_manual_2D_guides_not_metric.guide_usage: Locate separate negative spaces, not a calibrated3D trace or physical dimension. Imageheld orientation differs from installed world.

rear_scallops.original_smooth_negative_boundary: For lower half only, change rearY by−.035*(1−((Xrear−Xcentre)/.032)^2)^3 inside each support; C2zero at boundaries. Propagate through existing rear sections, never as a dark texture.
rear_scallops.function_or_fork_compatibility: unknown; do not name these forkholes or infer mechanical fit
rear_scallops.central_keyhole: documented observable but not built in this stage; next distinct feature
rear_scallops.only_new_unit: Two rear open-edge scallops; no pads, ribs, paint, mechanical pose or other sourcechange.
